goal: Tune around the locked PPO baseline rather than re-open the whole design.

fixed_params.net_arch_note: Fixed to match lunar_rl_common.policy_kwargs; not tuned in Optuna.

n_steps.why: Main rollout-depth lever. Kept broad enough to test shorter vs deeper trajectories without exploding compute.

batch_size.rule: Keep only values <= n_steps * n_envs and divisors of n_steps * n_envs
batch_size.why: Search only clean mini-batch sizes; avoid truncated minibatches.

n_epochs.why: Enough room to test less vs more reuse of each rollout, without going to clearly over-aggressive values.

learning_rate_start.why: Focused around the baseline you locked; avoids wasting trials on very low rates that mostly under-train.

learning_rate_end.why: Late cool-down only. Small discrete set is enough.

schedule_flat_until_progress.why: Controls when the late schedule starts. 0.25 means decay begins after 75% of training.

gamma.why: Search near your long-horizon preference without reopening obviously short-horizon values.

gae_lambda.why: Reasonable GAE band around the locked baseline.

clip_range.why: Let PPO be a bit more conservative or a bit freer, without going to silly extremes.

ent_coef_start.why: Most relevant exploration knob for your goal. Focused but not timid.

ent_coef_end.why: How much exploration remains in the final quarter.

target_kl.why: Guardrail search; avoids too-tight early stopping.

vf_coef.why: Lets the critic be a little weaker or stronger without dominating the loss.

max_grad_norm.why: Useful stability knob; discrete values are enough.

activation_fn.why: Optional. Tanh is your baseline; ReLU is the only alternative worth checking in this setup.

search_strategy.phase_1: Tune the core PPO dynamics first: n_steps, batch_size, n_epochs, learning_rate_start, gamma, gae_lambda, ent_coef_start, target_kl.
search_strategy.phase_2: Only if phase_1 plateaus, extend search to learning_rate_end, ent_coef_end, clip_range, vf_coef, max_grad_norm.
search_strategy.phase_3: Optional: activation_fn and ortho_init; net_arch is fixed.
